recognize_zh: 血片中央有一個新月形（香蕉形）配子體，周圍大量正常大小紅血球含細小環狀體與多重感染，並可見含褐色瘧色素的帶狀核中性球，以及小淋巴球／有核紅血球與較大的反應性單核細胞，綜合符合惡性瘧原蟲感染。
features: Crescent (banana-shaped) gametocyte in the center of the field
Numerous small delicate ring forms in normal-sized red cells, some cells with multiple rings or appliqué forms
Band and segmented neutrophils, two containing brown hemozoin pigment granules (left shift)
Large mononuclear cell with folded nucleus and abundant pale cytoplasm (monocyte or reactive lymphocyte) and a small dark round cell (small lymphocyte vs nucleated red cell)
Smudged/disrupted cell at the upper right; platelets sparse
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows heavy parasitemia with numerous small, delicate ring forms in normal-sized erythrocytes, including multiply infected cells and appliqué forms, and a single crescent-shaped gametocyte in the center of the field. Band and segmented neutrophils are present, two of which contain brown hemozoin pigment granules, indicating a left shift with pigment-laden neutrophils. A large mononuclear cell with a folded nucleus (monocyte versus reactive lymphocyte) and a small dark round cell (small lymphocyte versus nucleated red cell) are also seen, and a disrupted cell lies at the upper right. Findings are consistent with Plasmodium falciparum malaria.

ddx.vs: Vivax shows enlarged red cells with Schüffner dots, ameboid trophozoites and round gametocytes, not crescent gametocytes in normal-sized cells.
Malariae has band-form trophozoites, rosette schizonts and round gametocytes with low parasitemia, unlike this heavy multiply infected picture.
Babesia lacks pigment and gametocytes and may show tetrads and extracellular forms.
Sickle cells are entire red cells with pointed ends and no chromatin dots or internal pigment, unlike a crescent gametocyte with nuclear chromatin and pigment.
